title: Liability for rental or U-drive motor vehicle.
bodyText: Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, any registered owner of record who is the lessor of a rental or U-drive motor vehicle, including those defined in section 286-2, shall be liable for any summons or citation issued pursuant to this chapter. The registered owner shall not be precluded from pursuing reimbursement from any applicable renter or lessee.
bodyHtml: [§291L-8]  Liability for rental or U-drive motor vehicle.  Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, any registered owner of record who is the lessor of a rental or U-drive motor vehicle, including those defined in section 286-2, shall be liable for any summons or citation issued pursuant to this chapter.  The registered owner shall not be precluded from pursuing reimbursement from any applicable renter or lessee. [L 2024, c 112, pt of §2]
